package rulefixtures

import (
	"io"
	"net/http"

	yaml "gopkg.in/yaml.v2"
)

// scenario for yaml_unmarshal_untrusted_input: `yaml.Unmarshal(untrustedInput, &target)` using `gopkg.in/yaml.v2` without size limits
// fixture polarity: positive; family: security; severity: warning.
type Config struct {
	Host string `yaml:"host"`
	Port int    `yaml:"port"`
}

func scenario750Positive(r *http.Request) (*Config, error) {
	body, err := io.ReadAll(r.Body)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	var cfg Config
	if err := yaml.Unmarshal(body, &cfg); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &cfg, nil
}
